source.doc_type: CAR disclosure with reviewed consolidated and separate interim financial statements 1Q2025 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (3 months to 31 March 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated). Phillip Life Assurance. Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers; printed folio + 12 = file page). CAR disclosure p.1-3, review report (Deloitte) from p.4. Units differ: the SCI (p.8) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. The SCI has consolidated and separate columns; the separate columns are used (owner decision: separate statements); the subsidiary's share of profit (equity method) is included in other income, as in FY2025. Note 6.1 (columns non-PAA 7.1 / PAA 7.2 / total; 3 months): revenue p.50, expenses p.51; incurred claims and acquisition amortisation include PAA. CSM roll-forward (note 7.1, reconciliation by measurement component, ณ วันที่ 31 มีนาคม 2568) p.56-57; future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). New business p.60; totals used (the onerous column shows a CSM of 11,665, as later). Insurance service result is a loss (onerous losses 45,692). RA release uses note 6 (6,081), equal to the AOC RA. Other expense = finance costs + other operating expenses. In Q1 the three-month profit or loss is the year-to-date column.
